**POSITION SUMMARY**

This role is responsible serving as a senior strategic partner to the CMO and leading and streamlining marketing operations establishing the governance, operating rhythms, resources, budgets, agency model, workflows, and launch disciplines needed to drive focus, discipline, speed, and accountable execution. Partners with the CMO and Marketing Leadership Team to prioritize high-value opportunities, align teams and resources, and ensure programs are sufficiently financially viable, operationally executable, teams are aligned around shared priorities, and ready for successful systemwide launch and execution.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Social Media Manager, you’ll shape how audiences discover and engage with our brand across social media platforms. You’ll plan social media marketing, create compelling content, and use social listening and analytics to guide decisions. Your impact: By turning audience insights into relevant content and timely communication, you’ll help customers find useful information and strengthen their connection with the brand.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage social media content calendars, campaigns, and content creation across platforms.
* Write, proofread, and edit posts; coordinate photography, graphic design, and video editing using media editing tools and Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Monitor conversations, manage relationships with audiences, and coordinate public relations responses in line with brand standards.
* Track social media analytics, marketing online analytics, and media performance analytics with Google Analytics and platform tools; share findings and recommendations.
* Support digital marketing performance monitoring through SEO, keyword research, Facebook Advertising, and e-commerce campaign analysis; use Hootsuite or Buffer to schedule and manage content.
* Scout clients to sell our marketing services to. This role requires a bit of sales experience in order to receive payment.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in social media management, social media communication, social media content marketing, or digital marketing.
* Ability to create clear, engaging content and apply branding, content writing, proofreading, and visual storytelling skills.
* Familiarity with social media analytics, marketing analytics, web analytics, and performance reporting; able to interpret results and recommend improvements.
* Working knowledge of social listening, SEO, keyword research, and paid social advertising; Facebook Advertising experience is useful.
* Experience with Hootsuite or Buffer and Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator, is preferred; photography, graphic design, and video editing skills are also valued.
* Expertise Marketing via Social media to acquire new clientele

Pay: Up to $150.00 per day

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer( Deferred Agreement)
jobs.description:
**Pay:** $80,000.00 - $81,001.23 per year

Job description:

\*\*About\*\*

CulinaryFleet is a curated food & beverage platform that connects consumers, businesses, restaurants, and bars with high-quality, vetted, and credentialed culinary professionals—including chefs, bakers, and bartenders. Our mission is to modernize how culinary talent is discovered, booked, and supported, creating a trusted ecosystem for both service providers and clients.

\*\*Role Overview\*\*

CulinaryFleet is seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) with deep experience in hospitality and go-to-market (GTM) execution. The ideal candidate is a brand builder, growth strategist, and analytical leader who can drive growth through data-informed storytelling, customer engagement, and scalable acquisition strategies.

As a key member of the executive leadership team, the CMO will help shape the company’s growth trajectory, market positioning, and expansion strategy while building the marketing function from the ground up.

This position begins as a part-time executive role and is designed to evolve into a full-time leadership position based on company growth, funding milestones, and market expansion objectives as CulinaryFleet expands nationally and internationally.

\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

\* Develop and execute CulinaryFleet’s multi-channel marketing strategy with a strong GTM focus across digital, social, partnership, and experiential channels.

\* Build and maintain a powerful and consistent brand identity aligned with CulinaryFleet’s mission, values, and long-term vision.

\* Lead user acquisition, engagement, retention, and customer lifecycle strategies for both service providers and clients.

\* Partner with the CEO and executive leadership team to develop growth strategies, market expansion plans, and customer acquisition models that support company objectives.

\* Lead product positioning, market research, competitive analysis, and customer insight initiatives to strengthen product-market fit and market differentiation.

\* Collaborate with executive leadership to refine positioning, messaging, and value propositions across all target segments.

\* Establish and track key performance metrics to assess marketing ROI, customer acquisition costs, conversion rates, engagement, retention, and overall brand impact.

\* Build scalable marketing processes, reporting frameworks, technology platforms, and customer engagement systems to support long-term growth.

\* Manage, recruit, mentor, and grow an agile marketing team composed of internal talent, contractors, agencies, and strategic partners.

\* Direct public relations, media relations, thought leadership, and partnership initiatives within the culinary, hospitality, and food service industries.

\* Oversee launch campaigns, membership drives, strategic partnerships, and key milestone rollouts in new and existing markets.

\* Use data, analytics, and customer insights to continually optimize GTM strategies, campaign performance, and customer engagement.

\* Support fundraising efforts through market analysis, growth narratives, investor materials, and strategic communications as needed.

\*\*Qualifications\*\*

\* 10+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, ideally within hospitality, food & beverage, technology, marketplace platforms, or related industries.

\* Proven expertise in go-to-market (GTM) strategy development and execution, with a track record of driving measurable growth.

\* Strong understanding of both B2C and B2B growth models, customer acquisition strategies, and brand development.

\* Experience leading brand launches, market expansion initiatives, or early-stage growth efforts within startup environments.

\* Demonstrated ability to build marketing functions, processes, and teams from the ground up.

\* Strong understanding of performance marketing, customer lifecycle management, analytics, and data-driven decision making.

\* Exceptional communication, strategic thinking, analytical, and leadership skills.

\* Experience working cross-functionally with executive leadership, product, operations, sales, and external stakeholders.

\* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven, entrepreneurial, and remote-first environment.

\*\*Equity is set at 1.5%\*\*

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: Remote

Pay: $80,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal, Marketing, Tri-Built
jobs.description:
Overview:

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What you will do::

The Principal of TRI-BUILT Brand and Product Marketing owns the strategy and marketing performance of QXO's TRI-BUILT private-label portfolio. This individual contributor will strengthen the brand, accelerate product adoption, and lead integrated programs that support revenue, margin, penetration, and customer loyalty.

The role connects Marketing with Sales, Category Management, Supply Chain, Digital, Finance, Legal, Operations, manufacturers, and agency partners. The Principal will lead an expanding pipeline of product launches as TopBuild, Kodiak, and other products transition to TRI-BUILT branding.

**The** ***preferred*** **location for this role is: Herndon, VA; Coppell, TX; and/or Atlanta, GA**

**Brand and Portfolio Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own and evolve the TRI-BUILT brand strategy, positioning, messaging, visual identity, and customer value proposition across categories and channels.
* Develop annual marketing priorities, growth plans, budgets, and investment recommendations aligned with QXO revenue and margin objectives.
* Build relationships with division, region, branch, and sales leaders and use field insight to shape practical programs that drive adoption.
* Develop strategies that increase awareness, trial, repeat purchase, and share of wallet among priority customer segments.

**Product Launches and Content**
--------------------------------

* Lead go-to-market strategy for new products, category expansions, product transitions, and discontinuations.
* Manage the launch roadmap for products transitioning to TRI-BUILT branding, including sequencing, dependencies, readiness, and field communications
* Partner with Category Management and manufacturers to define target audiences, competitive positioning, key benefits, proof points, and launch requirements.
* Oversee packaging, product data, images, installation guides, comparison tools, sell sheets, catalogs, and other product assets for accuracy and brand consistency.
* Ensure QXO.com product listings and digital content are complete and ready for launch, resolving visibility and catalog issues with Digital and IT.

**Campaigns and Field Enablement**
----------------------------------

* Develop integrated campaigns and promotions that connect customer opportunities, product priorities, field execution, and measurable financial outcomes.
* Own signature TRI-BUILT programs and partnerships, including Top Dogs, and guide participation in trade shows, branch activations, customer events, and branded merchandise.
* Partner with Hispanic Marketing and channel leaders on culturally relevant, in-language campaigns, training, and digital experiences.
* Equip sales and branch teams with practical tools, product resources, presentations, and training, supported by a consistent communication rhythm.

**Performance and Cross Functional Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Establish and report measures for TRI-BUILT sales, gross margin, penetration, customer adoption, campaign performance, and return on investment.
* Analyze performance by division, region, branch, customer segment, and category to identify growth opportunities and recommend action.
* Manage the TRI-BUILT marketing budget, forecasts, expenses, accruals, invoice approvals, and vendor-funded opportunities with Finance.
* Lead through influence across internal teams, manufacturers, vendors, and agencies by setting clear priorities, owners, timelines, and quality expectations.

What you will bring::

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Seven or more years of progressive experience in brand management, product marketing, portfolio marketing, channel marketing, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated success developing marketing strategies tied to revenue, margin, product adoption, customer retention, or market-share outcomes.
* Experience leading product launches and integrated B2B campaigns across digital, field, sales enablement, events, and communications channels.
* Strong financial and analytical skills, including budget ownership, business-case development, forecasting, KPI design, and ROI analysis.
* Excellent executive communication and influence skills, with the judgment to simplify complex issues and align senior stakeholders.
* Credibility with field sales and operations teams and the ability to turn strategy into practical programs without formal authority.
* Experience in building products, distribution, construction, manufacturing, private label, or another technical product environment is strongly preferred.

What you will earn::

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

***QXO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*** *We value diversity and do not discriminate* *on the basis of* *race, color, religion,* *gender or sexual orientation**, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.*

jobs.title: Marketing Manager - Dealer
jobs.description:
**Company:**  
Kem Krest is a $600M, certified minority-owned business (MBE) and trusted partner to OEMs for scalable, high-performance supply chain solutions. Kem Krest specializes in complete 4PL services for aftermarket parts and service fluids fulfillment – from sourcing and supplier management, to inventory ownership, through dealer fulfillment.

Well beyond 3PL commodity logistics, Kem Krest offers OEMs bespoke chemical blending and down-packing solutions, the ability to kit complex parts and accessories, regulatory compliance expertise, and a network of more than 15,000 dealer touchpoints. We have over 45 years of experience working with leading OEMs in the Automotive, Heavy-Duty, and Powersports industries, and are supporting a growing number of OEMs in Construction, Mining, and Agriculture. Kem Krest has 11 locations throughout the U.S. and Canada.

**Opportunity:**  

Kem Krest is seeking a Marketing Manager – Dealer to own the strategy and execution that grows our share of wallet within existing OEM dealer programs. You will develop a deep understanding of dealership parts and service audiences, translate customer and purchasing insights into actionable marketing strategies, and lead campaigns and promotions that increase active dealer participation, purchase frequency, and incremental revenue.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this individual contributor will collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Supply Chain, OEM customers, and suppliers. This is a hands-on builder role for a marketer who is equally comfortable analyzing complex data, conducting Voice of Customer research, developing campaign strategies, and writing compelling copy.

This is a fully remote position with a strong preference for candidates located in the Midwestern United States, including the Detroit, Chicago, and Indianapolis markets. The role requires approximately 20–25% travel for dealership visits, customer research, industry events, trade shows, and periodic visits to Kem Krest locations

* Develop and maintain dealer personas and buyer journeys spanning onboarding, repeat purchase, reactivation, and advocacy.
* Lead the dealer campaign and promotions calendar across email, digital, direct marketing, events, and promotional programs.

* Create dealer-facing value propositions, campaign concepts, emails, offers, and sales tools that connect with dealership parts and service audiences.
* Partner with the Digital Marketing Manager and shared marketing operations resources to execute campaigns within established digital, automation, reporting, and channel standards.
* Manage the dealer marketing budget and agency relationships, evaluating promotional economics, volume lift, margin impact, and overall return on investment.
* Maintain accurate dealer contact coverage across HubSpot and D365 while supporting applicable marketing, Quality Management System, safety, and regulatory requirements.

  

**Your Contributions:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field preferred.
* At least 10 years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including ownership of integrated campaign strategy and execution for a distributor, dealer, reseller channel, or comparable install base.
* Advanced analytical skills with experience working directly with transactional, purchasing, ERP, or CRM data using tools such as Excel, Power BI, D365, and HubSpot.
* Hands-on experience developing customer segmentation, measuring incremental lift, and translating purchasing behavior into targeted marketing action.
* Demonstrated experience developing pricing, promotional, or offer strategies, including modeling economics and evaluating volume lift against margin.
* Experience conducting Voice of Customer interviews and survey research and converting findings into actionable personas, buyer journeys, and campaign strategies.
* Strong creative, writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to develop campaign concepts and copy while effectively directing agency partners.
* Knowledge of automotive, aftermarket, heavy-duty, powersports, industrial B2B markets, or dealership parts and service operations is highly desirable. Lean Six Sigma training is a plus.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
Description:

**ABOUT BAHAMA BUCK’S**

At Bahama Buck's, our mission is to provide the ultimate tropical dessert experience to our guests. Our marketing department shapes this mission by creating brand awareness, inviting new guests into our shops, and ensuring that our flavorful, friendly, and fun approach is top of mind for our guests and the communities we serve.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Specialist supports brand awareness and business growth by managing Bahama Buck’s online presence and executing impactful, data-informed digital campaigns that support positive ROI and increase guest traffic.

This role supports the planning, execution, and optimization of national digital initiatives, including social media, paid digital advertising, content strategy, SEO, and online reputation management. The Digital Marketing Specialist collaborates across departments, supports franchisees with scalable local digital marketing solutions, and ensures digital content reflects both brand integrity and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, highly organized, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple digital projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Digital Strategy**

* Support the development and execution of digital marketing strategies across paid and organic channels
* Monitor KPIs, reporting rhythms, and performance data to identify insights and opportunities
* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure digital initiatives support broader marketing and company goals
* Support the execution and maintenance of scalable local digital advertising solutions for franchisees

**Paid Digital Media**

* Build, manage, and optimize paid digital campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Google, and emerging platforms
* Monitor budgets, pacing, targeting, and campaign performance using guest and platform data
* Assist with campaign post-mortems and communicate performance insights and recommendations to the marketing team
* Build and maintain content calendars, monitor engagement, and respond to guest interactions
* Monitor emerging social trends and recommend relevant opportunities for the brand

**Digital Reputation & SEO**

* Maintain accurate shop listings across Google, Facebook, Apple, and Yelp and support quarterly audits
* Support bahamabucks.com content updates and SEO initiatives, helping maintain strong site health and organic growth

**Content Creation & Management**

* Coordinate content shoots in collaboration with the creative and video teams
* Participate in digital content brainstorming and ensure all content reflects brand standards and operational excellence
* Produce photography, short-form video, and blog content as needed

**Franchisee Support**

* Provide digital marketing guidance, training, and support to franchisees
* Maintain necessary access to local shop accounts and respond to digital-related questions and requests
* Help develop and provide digital marketing resources and tools that enable franchisees to effectively market their shops locally

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Digital Media, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; high school diploma or GED required
* 1–3 years of digital marketing experience; multi-location or franchise brand experience preferred
* Working knowledge of digital marketing strategy, local search, online customer acquisition, and engagement
* Experience executing and optimizing paid digital campaigns
* Proficient in social media management tools and platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, YouTube, Google Business Profile Manager, and Meta Business Suite
* Experience with SEO, GA4, and web content management preferred
* Photography and videography experience preferred; strong understanding of content direction
* Experience creating short-form video content for Reels/TikTok
* Strong copywriting and editing skills
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite preferred
* Must be self-directed, highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple digital projects simultaneously

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Audiense is the audience intelligence platform trusted by global brands, agencies, and publishers to help them understand, segment, and activate their audiences. Our technology enables marketers to connect the dots between social data, cultural signals, and customer behavior — turning insight into marketing action.

We’re looking for a proactive and organized specialist in paid media strategy and management to join our growing marketing team. This role is ideal for a data-driven marketing expert who’s eager to take ownership of paid media strategies, collaborate cross-functionally, and help fuel demand and engagement across every stage of the customer journey.

Audiense is seeking a strategic and hands-on **Marketing Manager, Organic Growth & Campaigns** to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of our organic marketing initiatives. This role will deliver and manage campaigns across organic social, email, and account-based marketing channels, while partnering closely with Content, Design, Product, Sales, and Leadership.

The ideal candidate is both creative and analytical, with strong project management skills and a proven ability to turn business objectives into integrated campaigns that drive pipeline and revenue growth, strengthen brand awareness, and engage audiences.

**Responsibilities**

**Campaign Strategy and Execution**

* Lead the development of integrated organic marketing campaigns from ideation through execution, measurement, and optimization.
* Translate company priorities, product launches, customer insights, and market trends into compelling campaign concepts.
* Build campaign briefs, timelines, messaging frameworks, and distribution plans.
* Coordinate cross-functional campaign execution across Content, Design, Product, Sales, and Leadership.
* Ensure campaigns are aligned with brand positioning, audience needs, and broader go-to-market objectives.
* Monitor campaign performance and use insights to improve future initiatives.

**Organic Social Media**

* Manage the organic social media strategy across relevant channels, including LinkedIn and other priority platforms.
* Develop and manage content calendars aligned with company priorities, campaigns, product updates, industry trends, and customer stories.
* Partner with Content and Design to create engaging, channel-specific social content.
* Write, edit, schedule, and publish posts while maintain
* ing a consistent brand voice.
* Monitor engagement, audience growth, and content performance.
* Identify opportunities to increase reach, conversation, and community engagement.
* Stay current on platform trends, evolving best practices, and emerging content formats.

**Email Marketing**

* Develop and manage the overall email marketing strategy in partnership with relevant stakeholders.
* Plan and execute promotional and campaign-based emails that support business and revenue goals.
* Create and manage ABM email campaigns tailored to target accounts, industries, segments, and buyer personas.
* Develop nurture campaigns and customer journeys that educate prospects, support consideration, and drive conversion.
* Partner with Content, Product Marketing, Sales, and Leadership to develop relevant messaging and offers.
* Manage email calendars, audience segmentation, personalization, testing, and reporting.
* Monitor key performance metrics, including engagement, conversion, pipeline influence, and revenue contribution.
* Continuously test and optimize subject lines, messaging, calls to action, timing, and audience targeting.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with the Content team to develop campaign messaging, thought leadership, educational resources, and supporting content.
* Partner with Design to translate campaign concepts into effective visual assets across email, social, and other channels.
* Work with Product and Product Marketing to communicate product updates, launches, use cases, and customer value.
* Collaborate with Sales and Account Executives to align ABM and lifecycle campaigns with account priorities and revenue objectives.
* Partner with Leadership to understand strategic priorities and communicate campaign plans, progress, and results.
* Act as the central point of coordination for organic campaign initiatives and ensure deliverables remain on track.

**Reporting and Optimization**

* Establish campaign goals, KPIs, and measurement frameworks.
* Report on organic social, email, campaign, and pipeline performance.
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Use audience and campaign insights to inform future messaging, segmentation, and channel strategy.
* Maintain organized documentation of campaign plans, results, learnings, and best practices.

**Qualifications**

jobs.description:
Excellent creative work can help extraordinary organizations raise more and serve more. Unseen is looking for a Marketing Director who knows what great looks like, can explain why it works, and can bring together the people who make it happen.

You will own Unseen's brand, voice, marketing strategy, and creative standard. You will lead an outside agency through a brand rebuild, turn that work into a focused annual marketing plan, and direct major projects for selected Unseen partners.

You will turn complex information into compelling ideas that capture attention, build belief, and motivate action. You will set creative direction and hold teams accountable for quality.

Creating amazing products and campaigns is the floor. Activating people to invest in anti trafficking work is the job.

About Unseen

Unseen accelerates the fight against human trafficking and its root causes. We equip anti-trafficking organizations around the world with marketing, fundraising, and storytelling tools, and we deliver strategic grants that fund their most critical projects.

Since 2011, Unseen has worked with 94 partner organizations in 66 countries. Those partners have raised more than $119 million and served more than 1.3 million people.

We are entering a new chapter and investing in the leadership and creative work to support it.

The opportunity

This is a role for someone whose strength is creative judgment and leadership. You can recognize an exceptional idea, write a clear brief, give specific feedback, and push work further. You know how to recruit talented people and hold them to a high standard.

You will have direct access to Unseen's leadership, room to challenge assumptions, and the opportunity to shape work with lasting consequences. We want someone who can push back on the CEO's preferences, support their recommendations, and earn trust through their decisions.

You will lead through strategy, direction, and accountability, not by personally producing every asset. You will guide the standard of work, help identify outside talent, and collaborate with the people responsible for daily delivery.

Visibility and credibility. Build Unseen's visibility and credibility among priority donors and businesses, activating established relationships and advocates in selected markets.

Fundraising communications. Set the strategy and creative direction for campaigns, stories, and materials that support philanthropic strategy, major gifts, Guardian Business expansion, and a major capital initiative.

Partner projects. Lead strategic and creative oversight for substantial marketing and storytelling assignments for selected Unseen partners, with scope and delivery commitments established through the annual plan.

* Resourcefulness within a limited budget, with the judgment to surface tradeoffs early and recommend solutions.
* Practical fluency with AI tools and the ability to lead adoption collaboratively.
* Respect for ethical, survivor-centered storytelling that protects dignity, informed consent, privacy, and personal agency.

An established network of creative professionals, agencies, media contacts, or business partners is a plus. Experience in anti-trafficking work is welcome but not required.

What success looks like

* Launch Unseen's brand rebuild and establish a consistent voice and creative standard.
* Build and execute a focused annual marketing plan with defined audiences, engagement goals, and performance measures.
* Provide creative direction and quality oversight for priority campaigns and partner projects delivered by the responsible teams against agreed goals, schedules, and budgets.
* Equip our fundraising and Guardi

jobs.title: Digital & Social Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About ARTECHOUSE**
====================

ARTECHOUSE is the nation's first innovative art space dedicated to experiential and technology-driven art. Working at the intersection of art, science, and technology, we create immersive exhibitions in New York, Washington DC, and Houston that redefine how audiences experience art.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how ARTECHOUSE shows up online and turn that presence into audience and ticket sales growth. You'll set strategy and lead execution across our website, social channels, email, influencer and creator partnerships, and paid media.

Beyond traditional channel management, this role is explicitly focused on architecting, deploying, and managing customized AI agents and automated workflows. Much of your execution capacity will come from a team of AI agents that you design, deploy, and manage, covering content ideation, ad optimization, customer journey automation, and reporting. You'll decide what agents do, connect them to our tools, and review their work so quality stays high and our voice stays human.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Core digital marketing strategy and execution**

* 360° digital campaigns: Lead and execute high-performing digital marketing across email, social media, content production, website, paid digital media, and search to grow audiences, ticket sales, and brand awareness.
* Set the strategy for each social platform (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and new channels as they emerge).
* Plan content around exhibitions, events, and seasonal moments in each city, and grow engaged local audiences through community management.
* Build and run the influencer and creator program: sourcing, outreach, hosted visits, contracts, FTC disclosure, and performance tracking.

### **Paid media:**

* Plan, build, and run all paid campaigns in house on Meta, Google and AI searches, including budget by location, audiences, creative testing, retargeting, and attribution to ticket sales.
* Set benchmarks, structure campaigns, manage bids and budget pacing, and audit spend efficiency.
* Report on spend, return on ad spend, and cost per ticket.

### **Website, ticketing, and email**

* Own the website and location pages: content, exhibition launches, SEO, UX, and conversion rate optimization with internal and external technical partners.
* Monitor ticketing platform performance, conversion, and promotions so the purchase path stays smooth.
* Direct email and newsletter strategy, keeping brand, visuals, and storytelling consistent across all channels.

### **Planning, collaboration, and leadership**

* Own the master digital marketing calendar for exhibitions, private events, press, and company priorities.
* Partner with marketing and location teams on launches, collateral, and revenue initiatives.
* Supervise and mentor AI agents, junior marketing staff/interns, and freelancers.

### **AI agents and automation**

* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows for content drafting, scheduling, audience segmentation, asset tagging, lead nurturing, and admin tasks.
* Run agents that pull cross-channel data into regular performance and ROI reports, with forecasts where the data supports them.
* Keep a human in the loop: review agent output before it goes public, and own accuracy, brand voice, and data privacy.
* Document each agent's purpose, inputs, tools, and owner so the system can scale and be handed off.
* Research and pilot new AI tools, and recommend which ones to adopt, scale, or retire.

**Qualifications & Requirements**
---------------------------------

* 4+ years in digital marketing, running multi-channel campaigns across paid, social, email, and SEO/SEM.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, with results tied to sales or bookings, building and optimizing campaigns yourself rather than through an agency.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered advertising, such as Meta Advantage+ and Google Performance Max campaigns, AI-generated and AI-tested ad creative, and emerging ad placements in AI search and assistants.
* Proven experience creating AI agents yourself, not just using AI tools: designing their instructions, connecting them to data and tools, and putting them into real workflows. Examples include custom GPTs or Claude projects, agent builders, automation tools. Be ready to show work you've built.
* Comfort with GA4, ticketing or e-commerce conversion data, and reporting dashboards.
* Willingness to experiment with new tools, APIs, and integrations.
* Strong organization across complex schedules, exhibition rollouts, and many stakeholders.
* A strong visual and editorial eye, with clear writing.
* A genuine interest in digital art, immersive experiences, and emerging media.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in arts, culture, attractions, live events, or ticketed experiences.
* Multi-location or multi-market marketing experience.
* Experience supervising staff, interns, or freelancers.
* Short-form video production or editing skills.

**Salary:** 75,000–115,000 per year, commensurate with experience  
  
**This is a Hybrid/Remote role but candidates must be commutable to either NYC or Washington DC.**

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

  
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 Annually

**Position Summary**

Nationwide Transport Services is seeking a data-driven and detail-oriented SEO Analyst to strengthen our organic search presence, increase qualified website traffic, and generate more leads for our vehicle transportation and logistics services.

The SEO Analyst will support the development and execution of search engine optimization strategies designed to improve visibility across search engines and AI-powered search platforms. This role will focus on keyword research, technical SEO, website content optimization, competitor analysis, performance reporting, and identifying opportunities to increase quote requests and customer acquisition.

The ideal candidate understands how customers search for auto transport and logistics services, including vehicle shipping, enclosed auto transport, open car shipping, motorcycle transport, dealer and auction vehicle transportation, and long-distance vehicle relocation.

This individual will work closely with marketing, content, web development, and operations teams to improve website performance and ensure SEO initiatives support measurable business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Keyword Research and Search Strategy**

* Conduct keyword research focused on vehicle shipping, auto transport, car hauling, vehicle relocation, and related transportation services.
* Identify high-intent keywords that attract customers actively seeking vehicle transportation quotes.
* Analyze search volume, keyword difficulty, search intent, competition, and conversion potential.
* Develop keyword maps for service pages, location pages, route-specific pages, and supporting blog content.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve rankings for commercially valuable search terms.
* Monitor changes in customer search behavior, seasonal demand, and industry-related search trends.

**2. On-Page SEO and Website Optimization**

* Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, image alt text, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Improve service pages covering open transport, enclosed transport, classic and luxury vehicle shipping, motorcycle shipping, and specialty transportation.
* Optimize origin-and-destination pages targeting vehicle shipping routes and geographic search demand.
* Evaluate existing content for relevance, accuracy, search intent, and opportunities to improve organic performance.
* Reduce keyword cannibalization and improve website architecture through effective keyword mapping and internal linking.
* Collaborate with content writers to create SEO-focused landing pages, educational resources, FAQs, and blog articles.

**3. Technical SEO**

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits to identify crawlability, indexation, duplicate content, broken links, redirect, canonicalization, and metadata issues.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, and search engine indexing.
* Evaluate Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed, and website performance.
* Identify and communicate technical issues to web developers, providing clear documentation and recommendations.
* Monitor the SEO impact of website redesigns, page launches, URL changes, and site migrations.
* Help maintain a scalable website structure as service offerings and geographic landing pages expand.

**4. Local SEO and Geographic Optimization**

* Support local and regional SEO strategies where relevant to the company's service areas and business locations.
* Optimize location-specific landing pages and identify opportunities for organic visibility across key markets.
* Research geographic search trends related to vehicle shipping between cities, states, and major transportation corridors.

* Track organic sessions, impressions, clicks, keyword visibility, landing-page performance, and conversion activity.
* Analyze quote form submissions, click-to-call activity, and other available lead-generation events originating from organic search.
* Identify pages and keywords that generate qualified leads and recommend opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Develop recurring dashboards and reports that communicate performance trends, issues, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Measure the impact of SEO initiatives on qualified lead volume and overall customer acquisition.
* Work with marketing and sales teams to understand lead quality and identify opportunities to improve organic campaign performance.

**6. Competitor Analysis and Market Research**

* Monitor competing auto transport and vehicle shipping companies to identify changes in keyword rankings, content strategies, and organic visibility.
* Analyze competitor service pages, geographic coverage, content gaps, and backlink profiles.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the company's website through stronger content, better search intent alignment, and improved user experience.
* Track search engine algorithm updates and evaluate their potential impact on organic performance.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on competitive and market insights.

**7. AI Search Optimization and Emerging Trends**

* Monitor the impact of AI-powered search experiences, including Google AI Overviews and other relevant AI search platforms.
* Support Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) initiatives.

jobs.title: Email & Growth Marketer (Email, Content, SEO)
jobs.description:
**About us**

AchieveCE (achievece.com) is one of the fastest-growing, nationally accredited continuing education platforms in healthcare. We hold every major medical accreditation for healthcare CE/CME, and we run on our own proprietary software platform delivering best-in-class experiences for the industry.

We have delivered education to over 1,000,000 healthcare professionals since 2017.

**What you will own**

**Email and lifecycle (the core of this role)** Build and run our automated email program in our Email platform: onboarding, post-purchase, renewal reminders, winback, re-engagement. On-brand Copy writing. Branching at the right times to ensure each customer journey is optimized.

**Content and SEO** Plan and write content that reaches licensed professionals while they are searching for what their state requires. Work with our SEO team on structure, backlinks, and what gets built next.

**Building things that save time** We are not on Shopify or WordPress, so there is rarely a plugin for what we need. A lot of the work means moving data between systems, generating content across hundreds of state and profession combinations, and wiring up tools that do not ship with an integration. You should be comfortable reading API docs and building something that works creatively with our technical and marketing teams.

**Role fit**

Expect to spend roughly 80% of your time executing and 20% shaping strategy, with more of the second as you learn the business. We will set the priorities together. You own the work and execution.

This suits someone who would rather build the program than manage people who build it.

**What you need**

* Excellent copywriting and brand voice creation: You can write an email to an array of healthcare professional types that is clear, persuasive, and does not fall into gimmicky marketing lingo.
* Real experience building branching automated email flows, not just sending campaigns. We currently use Brevo (formerly SendinBlue) - so bonus points if you have experience setting up automations with it.
* Working knowledge of on-page and off-page SEO & content marketing, enough to plan and execute without hand-holding
* Comfort in a custom environment where you may have to build the thing you need
* You use AI to move faster on research, data, and tooling, and you write the actual copy yourself
* Background in e-learning, online education, B2C SaaS, subscription, or any business where customers buy repeatedly over years

**Who this is not for**

* If your experience is mostly Shopify or WordPress stores, this will most likely not be a fit
* If your answer to every problem is a Klaviyo flow, this will most likely not be a fit
* If you need a brand guide, a documented process, and a finished brief before you can start, this will most likely not be a fit
* B2B and enterprise demand generation backgrounds are not what we are looking for

**How this works**

You report to our Head of Growth and work alongside a developer, a subject matter expert on continuing education, and contractors running SEO and paid media. It is a small team and it moves fast.

Copy clears a compliance review before it ships, because our content has to satisfy accreditation and state rules. Some claims that are normal elsewhere are off limits here.

**How to apply**

Answer these four questions. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.

* Describe an automated email flow you built that branched on customer data. What triggered it, what decided each branch, and what did it do for the business?
* Describe something you built or automated with an API, a script, or an AI tool where no off-the-shelf integration existed. What was the problem, and what did you build?
* Paste one subject line and the first three lines of an email you wrote that performed well. Tell us why it worked.

Pay: $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. * Support additional prospect and account research that helps Sales focus its time on the highest-value opportunities.

**Account Intelligence & CRM Enrichment**

Partner with Revenue Operations to improve the quality and completeness of Vividly's account and contact data.

* Experience analyzing digital marketing and content performance, including paid media, website analytics, and SEO.

**Position: Director, Demand Generation**

**Location: Remote**

**About LRN:**

LRN is the world’s leading dedicated ethics and compliance SaaS company, helping more than 30 million people every year navigate complex regional and global regulatory environments and build ethical, responsible cultures. With over 3,000 clients across the US, EMEA, APAC, and Latin America—including some of the world’s most respected and successful brands—we’re proud to be the long-term partner trusted to reduce organizational risk and drive principled performance.

Named one of Inc Magazine’s 5000 Fastest-Growing Companies, LRN is redefining how organizations turn values into action. Our state-of-the-art platform combines intuitive design, mobile accessibility, robust analytics, and industry benchmarking—enabling organizations to create, manage, deliver, and audit ethics and compliance programs with confidence. Backed by a unique blend of technology, education, and expert advisement, LRN helps companies turn their values into real-world behaviors and leadership practices that deliver lasting competitive advantage.

**About the role:**

The Director, Demand Generation, North America, will lead the strategy and execution of demand generation programs focused on acquiring new leads and logos, and improving conversion rates across top-, mid- and bottom-of-funnel metrics. This leader will design and deliver integrated campaigns that increase engagement, optimize lead quality, and accelerate pipeline creation for LRN’s solutions across North America.

Working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Rev Ops, Agency Partners, and other Regional Marketing Directors, the Director will build scalable, data-driven, buyer intent-led programs that deliver measurable growth. The Director will also work closely with and guide SDR (Sales Development Representative) resources, ensuring strong coordination between marketing and inbound and outbound efforts to maximize conversion efficiency.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop and own the North America demand generation strategy, focusing on both new business acquisition and conversion rate improvement across all funnel stages.
* Manage a multi-channel budget.
* Lead integrated, multi-channel campaigns (digital, paid media, content syndication, email, nurture sequences, remarketing, webinars, PR and in-person events) to generate and nurture qualified leads.

* Report regularly on performance and ROI, driving continuous improvement initiatives.
* Share best practices and insights across the global marketing organization to elevate campaign effectiveness.

  
**Requirements**

**What we're looking for:**

* 8–10 years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, including 3+ years leading regional programs, both integrated and ABM campaigns.
* Proven success in optimizing funnel performance metrics in a B2B setting (e.g., MQL conversion, lead-to-meeting rate, etc.).
* Experience collaborating with and guiding BDR or SDR teams to improve conversion efficiency.
* Deep expertise with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot) and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
* Experience running ABM campaigns, paid media, SEO/SEM, and content-driven demand generation.
* Experience managing agency partners and cross-regional/cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, and/or technology industries.
* Strong familiarity with North American enterprise buyer journeys.
* Experience in a global marketing organization collaborating with regional counterparts.

  
**Benefits**  

* Flexible PTO plus US public holidays and Sick Time
* Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits
* Excellent 401K with employer match

* Health & Wellness reimbursements

* Employee Assistance Plan

As we celebrate our 40th anniversary, MCA is entering one of the most exciting chapters in our firm's history. Building on four decades of experience, trusted relationships, and design excellence, we're evolving alongside an ever-changing industry, expanding our capabilities, and investing in the people and strategies that will drive our next era of growth.

We're looking for an exceptional **Director | Growth Marketing** to help lead that charge.

jobs.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we’re looking to add a new **Senior SEO Manager** to the team.

Silverback’s next Senior SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search. You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses. Here’s what we expect from our Senior SEO Manager:

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategic Chops:** Responsible for driving and executing the strategy, innovation and performance of multiple client SEO strategies.
* **AI & LLM Expertise:** Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines. Ability to identify new opportunities
* **Analytical Skills:** Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
* **Client-Facing:** Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner.
* **Client Management:** Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships.
* **Tactical Execution:** Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale.
* **Innovation:** Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices.
* **Process/Delivery Improvements:** Identify opportunities to improve the SEO delivery and process to increase the value of the work or improve efficiency.
* **Data Analysis:** Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life.
* **Sales Support:** Work with the sales team to put together SEO strategy proposals and audits that align with their goals and objectives.

### **What You'll Need to Succeed**

* **Agency Background:** You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results.
* **Years of Experience:** We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 3 years of agency experience; 5+ years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required.
* **Client-Facing Comfortability:** This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients.
* **Embrace Complexity:** As a Senior SEO Manager, this role will be exposed to more complex and challenging situations. You have a strong ability to navigate complexity and tackle challenges head on.
* **AI Search Testing & Optimization:** You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out.
* **Business Acumen:** Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar.
* **Content Experience:** You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production.
* **Tools/Platforms:** You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog.
* **Get Sh\*t Done” Mentality:** You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king.
* **Adaptability & Growth:** Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.
* **Project & Time Management:** You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you.

### **Why Silverback?**

Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

* **Make an impact:** We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.
* **Get paid:** We hire the best and pay them generously.

jobs.title: Paid Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

FMO Media is a full-service digital marketing agency for professional services businesses. Since 2018 we have run our clients' entire marketing engine under one roof: social media, content, on-site video production, paid media, websites and branding. We serve mortgage, law, real estate, wealth management and health services, and we are growing into home services and skilled trades, led by solar.

We send our own videographers to film clients in person, at volume. Our team produces more than 37,000 pieces of content a month across the client base. Paid media is included in every package we sell, so the ads team touches a large share of our clients.

We are minority- and veteran-owned and fully remote. Real people do the work and AI makes them faster. We build brands strong enough that leads follow, and we tell clients exactly what is working, what isn't and what we are doing about it.

How we work: execution over conversation, industry fluency, ownership mentality and transparency.

**Role Mission**

Own FMO's paid social pipeline from ad strategy to monthly report, so every client campaign launches on time, tracks its leads correctly and gets reported on without anyone chasing it. About 80% of our ad work runs on Meta, followed by Google and TikTok.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You live in Meta Ads Manager. You have run paid social for a lot of clients at once and you liked it. You keep a 70-task board current every day without being reminded. When leads stop flowing at 4pm, you find the broken step and fix it that day. You can explain how an ad account, payment method, pixel and lead form connect, and you know why a report has to name its attribution window.

You care more about a signed client than a cheap click. You write clearly, follow up relentlessly and tell the truth when a campaign is underperforming. You work well inside a team where the Account Manager owns the client relationship and you own the paid account.

**Responsibilities and Expectations**

* Own the Ads Team Pipeline in Asana across roughly 40 live campaigns, plus proposals, builds and accounts on hold. Every task sits in the right stage and is updated within 1 business day of a change.
* Turn Account Manager ad requests into paid media proposals within 3 business days. Each one covers platform, objective, audience, budget, Special Ad Category and campaign structure.
* Confirm account readiness before any build starts: the client's own ad account, payment method, FMO access, healthy page and pixel, and signed paperwork. 100% of builds start ready.
* Launch approved campaigns within 5 business days of client approval and account readiness, mostly on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), plus Google and TikTok. Every ad is QA'd and previewed by the AM and client first.
* Set up Meta lead forms, call campaigns and lead routing into each client's CRM or lead sheet (Zapier, GoHighLevel or the client's IT team). Verify tracking at launch and at every report, and fix breaks within 1 business day.
* Optimize pacing, audiences, creative rotation and budget against each client's agreed cost per lead and lead volume, consulting the AM and client on budget changes.
* Deliver monthly reports on 100% of live campaigns by the 6th of each month, plus a first report within 14 days of every new launch. Join client calls to cover paid media when the AM brings you in.
* Coordinate the Paid Media Specialist: set weekly priorities, split builds and reporting, and be the first stop for questions.
* Keep admin access and recovery contacts documented on every account, so no account depends on one person.
* Post a daily end-of-day update in Slack: status, wins, risks and decisions needed.

**Required Experience and Skills**

**Required:**

* 2+ years hands-on in Meta Ads Manager, ideally at an agency running 20 or more client accounts at once
* Meta lead gen forms, call campaigns, Business Portfolio management and Special Ad Categories for housing, credit and employment
* Working knowledge of Google Ads and TikTok Ads
* Comfortable connecting lead routing with Zapier or a CRM and troubleshooting it when it breaks
* Daily project management in Asana or a similar tool
* Clear written English. Most of the work happens in Slack and Asana.
* Based in the US and available during Eastern business hours

**Preferred:**

* Advertising experience in mortgage, law, real estate or financial services
* GoHighLevel, CallRail, Supermetrics or YouTube ads
* Experience reporting cost per signed client from CRM data, not only cost per lead

**Benefits and Perks**

* Fully remote
* Paid time off
* 10 paid holidays
* Health Insurance reimbursement
* Referral bonus
* 401k + 401k match

**Schedule**

* Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm EST

Pay: From $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Work from home

Language:

* Fluent English (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**THE COMPANY – RISE BRANDS**

Established in 2013 and based out of Columbus, Ohio, Rise Brands is a highly collaborative organization with clearly defined core values. We develop edgy, immersive consumer engagements and bring them to life through unique brand experiences, such as 16-Bit Bar and Arcade, Pins Mechanical Company, and No Soliciting, a members-only speak-easy club.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Rise Brands is looking for a hands-on Marketing Director to set the direction for how our brands show up, then turn that direction into relevant campaigns and local experiences across our venue portfolio. This leader will connect the corporate office, external agency partners, creative and social teams, and venue leaders so that brand strategy is clear, work is coordinated, and each location has a meaningful place in its community.

The role balances enterprise brand building with practical field execution. The Director will own the marketing plan and operating rhythm, guide agency work, equip local teams to activate, and use results to improve what we do next.

**WHAT YOU WILL LEAD**

**BRAND STRATEGY AND PLANNING**

* Set and maintain the marketing strategy for each brand, translating business priorities and guest insights into clear audiences, positioning, messages, campaign priorities, and channel roles.
* Build and own the annual marketing calendar, including seasonal campaigns, evergreen offers, programming, openings, product and menu launches, and market-specific opportunities.
* Recommend annual budgets and allocate spend against agreed priorities; bring clear business cases and tradeoffs to leadership for approval.

**AGENCY AND CORPORATE PARTNERSHIP**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between external agency partners and the Rise Brands corporate office. Set briefs, timelines, decision owners, and review expectations; make sure agency work reflects business goals and brand direction.
* Lead planning and performance conversations with agency partners, including PR and paid media/search support as assigned. Coordinate internal inputs, approvals, assets, and follow-through so work moves on time.
* Keep executives and cross-functional partners informed on plans, decisions, risks, and results; elevate choices that require leadership direction.

**COMMUNITY AND FIELD MARKETING**

* Build a practical local marketing approach for every venue market, with activations and partnerships shaped by local guests, calendars, organizations, and neighborhood needs.
* Create repeatable ways for venue leaders and a cross-functional marketing committee to surface local ideas and help execute them, with clear briefs, budgets, owners, toolkits, and approval steps.
* Develop relationships with local businesses, nonprofits, tourism groups, schools, sports and entertainment organizations, creators, and community event organizers.
* Plan and support in-market activations, partnerships, events, promotions, and community programs; travel regularly to venues and attend key activations as needed.

**CAMPAIGNS, CONTENT, AND BRAND STRATEGY**

* Lead integrated campaigns that support walk-in traffic, event sales, programming, guest spend, awareness, and retention, in partnership with Operations and Event Sales.
* Partner with creative and social teams to deliver useful, on-brand assets for venues and corporate channels, with clear content expectations and review processes.
* Protect consistency in brand voice and guest experience while making room for local relevance. Ensure venue teams receive timely, usable instructions and materials.

* Monitor budgets, vendor commitments, deadlines, and workload; coordinate with Finance and functional leaders to keep plans achievable.

* Clear brand standards and practical support that help venue teams execute confidently.

jobs.title: Paid Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**Job Title**

Paid Media Coordinator

**Department**

Media

**Employment Type**

3 Month Contract to Full-Time Hire

**Experience**

Entry-level / Experienced Entry-Level `

**Salary**

$28.5hr - $33.65hr ($60K - $70K)

**Role Purpose:**

The Paid Media Coordinator is a core support and execution-focused role within the Media team. The primary function is to assist the daily operational, tactical, and administrative requirements of media campaigns across content creators, endemic media, self-serve, auction-based platforms (primarily Google, and paid social). This position is responsible for ensuring the accurate setup, proper pacing, consistent monitoring, and quality assurance of campaign delivery, providing critical support to Senior Planners and Supervisors. This position is a three month contract with an opportunity to be transitioned to a full time role.

### **Core Functions and Responsibilities:**

The duties of this position are divided into four primary functional areas:

#### **1. Campaign Setup and Stewardship (40%)**

This function ensures the technical accuracy and continuous delivery of all live campaigns, as well as necessary administrative documentation.

* **Setup & QA:** Execute the complete technical setup of campaigns, including the accurate configuration of pixels, UTM tracking, creative uploads, ad creation, and trafficking for both Google, endemic media and paid social platforms.
* **Tracking Management:** Generate, compile, and QA all necessary UTM tracking links required for approved media plans.
* **Pacing & Delivery:** Conduct mandatory weekly (or as needed) checks on campaign pacing and delivery. Identify and proactively flag any under/over-delivery risks or budget discrepancies to the Supervisor/Planner.
* **Operational Coordination:** Liaise with Planners to maintain an updated tracking log of all pending materials (creative assets, ad copy, landing page URLs, client approval) required for campaign launch or maintenance.
* **Financial & Project System Support:** Assist the team with updating and maintaining internal financial tracking and project management systems to ensure accurate record-keeping of budgets, deliverables, and timelines.
* **Billing Support:** Assist the Media Planners/Director with monthly account reconciliation processes for media spend and documentation.
* **Data Contribution:** Gather and organize campaign performance data points to contribute to both internal performance reviews and external client reporting decks.

#### **2. Paid Social Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of biddable social campaigns.

* **Campaign Execution:** Implement and manage campaign settings and biddable formats across platforms (Meta, X, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit) to align with client goals (e.g., engagement, acquisition, awareness) as directed by the supervising Planner.
* **Audience Research:** Conduct and compile initial research on targeting parameters, audience segments, and competitor activity to support strategic planning phases.
* **Optimization Support:** Under supervision, perform routine campaign optimizations, including minor bid adjustments, budget shifts, and testing of new ad copy/creative within active campaigns.

#### **3. Influencer Execution Support (30%)**

This function supports the implementation and maintenance of influencer campaigns.

* **Identification & Outreach:** Assist in identifying, vetting, and coordinating outreach to relevant influencers and content creators based on audience demographics, brand alignment, and campaign goals.
* **Continued Communications:** Manage day-to-day communication with influencers and creator partners, including deliverable requirements, contracts, content timelines, posting schedules, tracking links, and campaign expectations.
* **Performance Review:** Monitor influencer campaign performance metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, and conversions, flagging any significant deviations from campaign goals.

### **4. Media Technology & Growth**

* **MarTech Stack:** Maintain working knowledge of the internal technology stack required for campaign execution, including budget management systems, data visualization tools, and ad verification platforms.
* **Measurement & Tagging:** Support the team by executing and validating third-party tracking implementation, including **Google Campaign Manager 360 (GCM) tagging and reporting** functionality.
* **Professional Development:** Proactively pursue necessary platform certifications (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Blueprint) and attend internal training sessions to ensure skills remain current with rapidly evolving media technologies.
* **Process Improvement:** Participate in internal meetings to share observations on operational efficiencies and contribute to the refinement of campaign setup and QA protocols.

Requirements:

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* **Experience:** Entry-level or 1-2 years of professional experience in communications, digital media execution, operations, or a similar role.
