**Position Overview**

MotorCars is seeking a results-driven Marketing Director to oversee the marketing and advertising strategy for both MotorCars Lansing and MotorCars Kalamazoo.

This position will report directly to the Owner and will be responsible for the overall marketing strategy, third-party vendor relationships, advertising budgets, campaign performance, and return on investment for both dealership locations.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Search Engine Marketing (SEM) and Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and be comfortable using data to make marketing decisions, manage budgets, and hold advertising vendors accountable for results.

Automotive marketing experience is a plus, but automotive experience is not required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and oversee the overall marketing and advertising strategy for MotorCars Lansing and MotorCars Kalamazoo.
* Manage marketing priorities across both locations while addressing the individual goals and needs of each dealership.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the dealerships' third-party marketing and advertising vendors.
* Work directly with vendors to develop, execute, and adjust marketing strategies and campaigns.
* Evaluate vendor performance and hold partners accountable for delivering measurable results.
* Manage all marketing and advertising budgets for both dealership locations.
* Track advertising spend by dealership, vendor, platform, campaign, and marketing channel.
* Maintain accurate reporting of marketing expenditures and campaign performance.
* Evaluate the Return on Investment (ROI) of existing marketing campaigns and third-party vendors.
* Make recommendations to continue, modify, expand, reduce, or replace marketing initiatives based on performance.
* Present marketing performance, advertising spend, ROI, and strategic recommendations directly to the Owner.
* Manage and evaluate SEM/PPC campaigns, including paid search.
* Develop and oversee SEO strategies designed to increase organic visibility and website traffic.Monitor key performance indicators, including website traffic, lead volume, conversions, cost per lead, advertising spend, and ROI.
* Compare performance against previous periods and identify opportunities for year-over-year growth.
* Coordinate marketing efforts across dealership websites, search engines, social media, email, digital advertising, and traditional media.
* Coordinate and execute occasional local television and radio media buys.
* Work with local TV and radio representatives to evaluate advertising opportunities, negotiate placements, coordinate creative, and manage associated budgets.
* Ensure dealership branding, messaging, promotions, and creative remain consistent across vendors and advertising channels.
* Create or modify basic marketing materials using Canva or similar creative platforms when needed.

**What a Typical Day Looks Like**

A typical day may include reviewing website traffic and lead performance for both dealerships, analyzing current advertising spend, communicating with third-party vendors, evaluating SEM and SEO performance, reviewing campaign creative, and approving or requesting changes to existing campaigns.

The Marketing Director may meet with digital advertising partners, website providers, SEO/SEM vendors, social media providers, and other third-party partners to discuss performance and develop strategies for upcoming campaigns.

On occasion, the Marketing Director may also work directly with local television and radio stations on media buys, including negotiating advertising opportunities, coordinating schedules and creative, and ensuring traditional advertising remains within the overall marketing budget.

The person in this role will be expected to turn this information into clear recommendations for dealership ownership.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of SEM and SEO.
* Experience managing marketing or advertising budgets.
* Ability to analyze digital marketing and campaign performance.
* Strong understanding of ROI, lead generation, conversion metrics, website traffic, and digital advertising performance.
* Experience managing or working directly with third-party marketing vendors.
* Ability to organize, track, and report marketing expenditures.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and project management abilities.
* Ability to manage marketing priorities across multiple locations.
* Ability to clearly communicate marketing strategy, performance, and financial results directly to ownership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Automotive dealership or automotive marketing experience is a plus, but not required.
* Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, and Meta advertising.
* Working knowledge of Canva and basic creative/design skills.
* Experience with social media, email marketing, website management, and digital advertising.
* Experience evaluating vendor contracts, advertising packages, and vendor performance.
* Experience with traditional media buying, including local television and radio, is a plus.
* Experience negotiating advertising opportunities and working directly with local media representatives is preferred.

**Compensation**

* Base salary: $70,000-$85,000 annually, based on the candidate's experience and qual

* Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Benefits**

**Join Our Team**

If you are a motivated Digital Marketing Specialist with experience managing online advertising, improving website visibility, and generating leads, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Principal, Head of Channel Marketing
jobs.description:
Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.
  
  
**What We Do**  
As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871.5 billion in non-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025.

  
  

**The Opportunity:**

Private markets continue to open to new investor bases, and the way capital is raised is being rewritten. Institutions are deepening their allocations. Evergreen and interval structures, expanding wealth platforms and advisor demand are bringing private markets to investors who have never had access before. The firms that win will understand every client segment better than anyone else and show up for each one with the right story, the right experience and the right timing.

  

The Head of Channel Marketing is a newly created role responsible for translating the firm’s commercial priorities into tailored marketing solutions for each client segment. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, this leader will work with Marketing, Client Solutions, Product and Investment to identify where growth will come from, then design and execute the full-funnel programs that capture it.

  

The role owns segmentation and audience strategy, and uses client insight, pipeline data and campaign performance to direct marketing investment toward the segments, platforms and accounts with the greatest opportunity. The Head of Channel Marketing is accountable for commercial outcomes, including pipeline created and influenced, conversion, assets raised, and client retention, and will build the strategy, team and processes for the channel marketing team.

  

**Your responsibilities will be to:**

* Define and own the channel marketing strategy and multi-year roadmap for each priority segment, tied to the firm’s commercial goals

* Own audience strategy across institutional and private wealth, and continually refine it with client insight, market intelligence and performance data

* Partner with Product and Product Marketing to ensure the brand narrative and product positioning are translated into segment-specific messaging pillars that are consistent across the firm and distinctive in the market

* Design full-funnel, multi-channel programs that drive awareness, engagement, conversion and retention across the client lifecycle, with clear targets for lead generation, pipeline and assets raised

* Support the full product and client lifecycle, from launch and capital raising through ongoing education, retention and expansion

* Build a trusted partnership with Client Solutions, aligning segment priorities, pipeline goals and coverage models, and provide the teams with the content, tools and insight they need to win

* Establish shared lead definitions, hand-offs and feedback loops between Marketing and Sales

* Set measurable goals and KPIs for every campaign/program, and report on engagement, pipeline contribution, conversion, assets raised and marketing ROI

Own channel budgets and manage agency and media partners, from brief through delivery, reallocating investment based on performance  

  

**Your background will include:**

* 12+ years of marketing experience in asset management, private markets, alternatives or wealth management, with at least 5 years leading teams

* A record of building from scratch: a channel strategy, a segmentation model, a team or a function that did not exist before you, and the results it delivered

* Proven commercial impact, with specific outcomes you can point to, such as pipeline created, conversion improved, or assets raised

* Experience owning segmentation and audience strategy, and shifting budget toward the segments and accounts that produce growth

* Hands-on use of AI, automation and marketing technology to launch faster, personalize at scale and improve campaign performance, with results you can quantify

* Command of investment products, client segments, distribution partners and the regulatory requirements for marketing in financial services; experience across institutional and wealth or intermediary audiences is a plus

* Strong digital, CRM, marketing automation and analytics skills, and the judgment to turn data into decisions

* Clear, concise communication of complex investment ideas to different audiences

Experience managing budgets and agency partners  

  

**Benefits**

At Hamilton Lane, our benefits philosophy is simple: to provide our employees with a competitive suite of benefits and services to help navigate through the complexities and challenges of working, living, raising a family, and eventually retiring. To do this, Hamilton Lane offers the following benefits:

  

**Enhancing Your Physical and Emotional Health**

Employees have access to healthcare coverage, mental health resources, health & fitness reimbursement program, and Wellness Rewards Program.

  

**Developing Your Career**

Tuition and certification reimbursement programs are available, along with continual education and development trainings for you to grow with Hamilton Lane.

  

**Supporting Your Family & Community**

For our communities, Hamilton Lane provides paid time off to volunteer and compensates for referring qualified candidates that join our team.

**What are Trust Fund Positions?**

Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**About M3:** A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

We are seeking a **Growth Marketing Consultant – B2B Strategy** to help our businesses develop scalable, targeted marketing strategies that drive qualified sales conversations, client acquisition, and commercial growth.

 **Job Description**

The Growth Marketing Consultant will partner with marketing and business development leaders across M3's subsidiaries to identify growth opportunities, develop effective B2B outreach strategies, and implement campaigns that generate measurable business results.

This position combines B2B marketing strategy, persona-drive outbound targeting, multi-channel sequencing, and some hands-on campaign execution. The ideal candidate has experience developing targeted growth programs, identifying key decision-makers within prospective client organizations, and translating market insights into actionable outbound strategies that generate qualified sales opportunities.

We are looking for someone who understands how to reach the right decision-makers, develop compelling messaging, and build repeatable marketing programs that convert prospective clients into qualified commercial opportunities.

Experience developing outbound marketing and growth strategies for B2B services is particularly relevant, especially healthcare services, professional services, staffing and recruitment, research, or other relationship-driven industries.

This is not primarily a paid advertising or traditional digital marketing role. Success requires experience with B2B demand generation, outbound marketing, and sales-aligned growth strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**B2B Growth Strategy & Consulting**

* Partner with marketing and business development leaders across M3’s subsidiaries to identify growth opportunities and build a targeted outbound strategy for each business.
* Build and own a full digital outreach path for each subsidiary, from identifying decision makers for each product to qualified handoff to the BD team.
* Define handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and target account lists with each subsidiary’s BD and marketing leads, and gather their feedback on message performance.
* Develop a repeatable outbound framework that can be adapted across business units, services, and buyer audiences.

**Audience Development**

* Define buyer personas and target account segments for each business’s sales activity.
* Identify the budget owners, decision makers, and influencers at target organizations, and grow contact lists from verified sources and research.
* Develop personalized messaging that speaks to the priorities of each specific audience, tailored by subsidiary.
* Convert M3’s proprietary data assets, such as its physician network and health-system relationships, into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions.

**Outbound Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, and other social and digital channels, with messaging tailored to each subsidiary.
* Design outreach sequences, messaging frameworks, and follow-up strategies that build familiarity before asking for time and generate qualified sales conversations.
* Test and refine messaging to improve reply rates, positive-reply rates, and pipeline contribution.

**Marketing Technology & AI**

* Operate each designated business unit’s outreach technology stack (sequencing, Sales Navigator), integrate it with their CRMs, and recommend new or more advanced tools.
* Use AI-assisted research and personalization to build account and contact intelligence and personalize at scale, with human review and M3 brand standards applied before anything sends.
* Coordinate with email deliverability specialists on authentication, IP warming, sender reputation, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements.

**Performance & Business Impact**

* Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona.
* Use the data to retire what doesn’t work and scale what does, and translate results into clear recommendations for business leaders.

jobs.description:
At SolarWinds, we're a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

**About the role**  
SolarWinds is looking for an Account Based Marketer to drive pipeline and revenue from our highest-value ITSM target accounts, across both new business and expansion within our existing customer base. Using intent data, you'll find in-market buyers, build vertical campaigns that speak to their priorities, and run targeted engagement programs that earn meetings. Data enrichment tools such as Clay will help you grow the number of marketable contacts within target accounts, and you'll write custom, targeted sales sequences to reach them.

Work arrangement  
**This is a hybrid role based in Austin, TX, with 3 days per week in our Austin office.**

**What you will do**

* Pipeline and revenue: Own ABM targets for sourced and influenced pipeline and revenue, across new logo acquisition and customer upsell, cross-sell and expansion.
* 6sense: Own the 6sense platform for ITSM. Build and maintain segments, account scoring, buying stage models and intent keyword sets. Launch 6sense advertising and orchestration plays and deliver account insights to sales.
* Sales sequences: Write custom, targeted sales sequences in for priority accounts, verticals and personas. Partner with sales to launch sequences tied to intent signals and ABM plays, and test messaging to improve reply and meeting rates.
* Customer expansion: Build plays that identify expansion signals in the installed base and help account managers grow existing customers into additional SolarWinds ITSM products and seats.
* Incentives and gifting: Build and manage meeting-for-incentive programs, survey offers, direct mail and e-gifting through platforms such as Sendoso, Reachdesk or Alyce to engage key contacts, drive qualified conversations and accelerate active deals.
* GTM alignment: Partner with sales, BDR and customer success leaders on target account lists built from SolarWinds ICPs, account plans, sales sequences and follow-up. Run regular pipeline reviews by segment and vertical.
* Measurement: Report on account engagement, contact enrichment, sequence performance, meetings booked, cost per meeting, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline created, velocity, win rates and expansion revenue for target accounts. Use results to refine targeting and spend.
* Collaboration: Coordinate with digital growth, demand generation, events and marketing operations so account plays connect across every channel.

**What you bring**

* 4 to 6 years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 2 years in account-based marketing, ideally in SaaS or IT software
* A track record of ABM programs that delivered measurable pipeline and revenue from both new logos and existing customers
* Hands-on experience administering 6sense (or Demandbase, Terminus or a similar ABM platform)
* Experience using Clay or similar data enrichment tools to expand contact coverage within target accounts, and writing sales sequences in Outreach (or Salesloft or a similar platform)
* Experience running vertical or industry-focused campaigns
* Experience managing incentive, gifting or direct mail programs, including vendors and budgets
* Proficiency with Salesforce and marketing automation (Marketo, Eloqua or HubSpot)
* Strong analytical skills and comfort reporting on pipeline and ROI
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative style with sales and customer success teams
* Strong writing skills, including sales sequences that drive replies and meetings

**Nice to have**

* 6sense certification
* Familiarity with ITSM, service desk or IT operations buyers and buying committees, and how to turn them into target account strategies
* Experience with Sendoso, Reachdesk, Alyce or similar gifting platforms
* Experience building Clay waterfall enrichment workflows across multiple data providers
* Experience with intent data, account scoring and buying stage models

SolarWinds will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

All applications are treated in accordance with the SolarWinds Privacy Notice: https://www.solarwinds.com/applicant-privacy-notice

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager is the campaign engine behind Blackboard’s new logo pipeline — and a critical connector between acquisition and the post-sale customer journey. **About Still Austin Whiskey Co**

Still Austin is the first true grain-to-glass whiskey distillery to open in Austin since the end of Prohibition. Founded in 2015, we craft award-winning spirits using grains sourced from Texas farmers and a relentless commitment to quality, creativity, and community.

Today, we're one of the fastest-growing craft whiskey brands in the United States, expanding our national footprint while staying true to the values that got us here: honoring the craft, never cutting corners, and building authentic relationships with our customers, distributors, and partners.

Still Austin Quarter (SAQ) is our six-acre South Austin campus and hospitality destination, bringing together our distillery, production operations, exceptional food and cocktails, live events, and immersive whiskey experiences. It's a major expression of where Still Austin is headed: ambitious growth without losing what makes us distinctly Austin.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Still Austin. As we continue to grow, we're looking for people who are passionate about building something uniquely Austin, uniquely authentic, and built to last.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Brand Manager is a key member of the Still Austin Marketing team responsible for developing and executing brand-building programs that drive awareness, trial, distribution, and growth across retail, national accounts, and the broader Still Austin portfolio.

This role will lead retail and national accounts marketing while providing strategic and executional support for emerging brands, innovation, and limited releases across the portfolio. The Senior Brand Manager will translate brand strategy and commercial priorities into compelling programs, tools, and activations that resonate with consumers and support our sales organization and distributor partners.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for a marketer who is equally comfortable setting strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute it. The Senior Brand Manager will serve as a primary brand owner, working independently and cross-functionally across a lean, entrepreneurial organization rather than managing a dedicated team.

This role is based in Austin, Texas and requires regular on-site presence at Still Austin's distillery and office, as well as periodic travel to support key customers, distributors, events, and market activity.

To be successful in this role, the Senior Brand Manager will:

jobs.description:
**CLIENT HIGHLIGHT**  
The client you will be working for is a Top 20 Fortune Global 500 Consumer Electronics and Technology Company. This opportunity will give you experience in the technology sector in the United States with a company that is a globally recognized leader in smartphones, televisions, home appliances, and semiconductor innovation — and one of the most well-known brands in the world.

**LOCATION**  
Plano, Texas, 75023

**COMPENSATION**  
$57.00 per hour

**SCHEDULE**  
Monday-Friday, 40 hours
  
Fully onsite

**CONTRACT TERM**  
12-month contract with high likelihood of extension or conversion to full-time employee

**POSITION OVERVIEW – Brand Marketing Communications Manager, Home Entertainment**  
You'll make sure everything customers see about TVs, audio, memory, and monitors looks right and says the right thing. You'll work day to day with the launch, go-to-market, and paid media teams, writing and polishing product copy, checking creative work against brand guidelines, coordinating translations for other markets, and tracking legal review so approved wording makes it into the final assets. You'll also keep launch toolkits and messaging documents organized and up to date. It's a hands-on role for someone who loves details and wants to protect the quality and consistency of a big product lineup.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Product Messaging Execution & Maintenance**  

* Execute product messaging across home entertainment launches and campaigns in line with the positioning frameworks and messaging architecture set by the Sr. Manager, writing and refining consumer-facing copy including headlines, feature callouts, and product descriptions
* Partner with the go-to-market (GTM) team to validate that messaging deliverables align with go-to-market strategy, launch timing, and channel-specific requirements
* Maintain a master messaging document for each product line, tracking approved copy, claim status, and version history as the cross-functional source of truth

**Brand Guidelines Application & Governance**  

* Apply and enforce brand guidelines across all creative assets, serving as a day-to-day brand steward for the integrated marketing team
* Review creative from internal teams and agency partners for adherence to global brand standards and category-specific guidance, flagging inconsistencies and coordinating revisions through to resolution
* Support the Sr. Manager in cascading brand guideline updates to relevant teams and documenting category-specific brand application rules

**Localization Execution & Quality Control**  

* Manage day-to-day execution of localization workflows for marketing assets, coordinating with translation vendors, regional teams, and the Integrated Marketing team to ensure on-time, accurate delivery
* Review localized assets against source files to confirm messaging intent, visual standards, and brand voice are preserved across all markets and languages
* Maintain organized records of localization scope, status, and approvals across all active launches and campaigns

**Creative Standards, Toolkit & Governance**  

* Apply established creative best practices to asset briefs, creative reviews, and production feedback, and keep the best practices library updated with new learnings from campaign performance and platform updates
* Support the development and ongoing management of product launch and campaign toolkits, ensuring assets are brand-aligned, messaging-approved, version-controlled, and include all required components before distribution
* Coordinate the day-to-day legal review process for creative assets, tracking submission status, ensuring approved language is accurately reflected in final deliverables, and flagging claims that need re-review
* Conduct thorough QA checks across all asset types before publication or distribution

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS**  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in brand marketing, content strategy, creative operations, or integrated marketing
* Strong copywriting and messaging skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate product features into brand-consistent, consumer-relevant content
* Solid understanding of brand guidelines, with hands-on experience applying and enforcing visual and verbal brand standards across multiple asset types
* Experience coordinating legal review processes and managing compliance documentation for marketing assets
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams across different product lines and campaigns
* Comfortable working cross-functionally with GTM, paid media, legal, and creative teams in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred**  

* Experience in consumer electronics, tech, or a related category
* Familiarity with eCommerce content workflows, including product detail page (PDP) execution
* Experience managing or supporting localization workflows across multiple markets
* Exposure to digital asset management (DAM) systems and creative production pipelines
* Experience building or maintaining toolkits, creative best practice libraries, or brand resource hubs
* Background working with or alongside HQ or global brand teams in a subsidiary or regional marketing structure

In this role, the BM will develop and own strategies for sustained long-term growth, drive brands toward improved operational performance, and build scalable programs that set the standard for the broader organization.

**Who We Are**
==============

Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

**What We Do**
==============

As part of our Performance Marketing Center of Excellence (CoE), the Marketing Operations Manager ensures the integrity of our marketing data, systems, and performance measurement. You will own the operational foundation that makes every marketing dollar accountable—driving consistency in tracking, reporting, and governance while enabling the team to scale. A key part of this role is unifying data across disparate systems into a trusted, single view of marketing performance, ensuring accuracy and availability for decision-making  
  
As a people leader, you will coach and develop talent while building scalable processes to support future team growth. By pairing strong leadership with operational rigor, you’ll help position the CoE as a trusted growth engine for the business.

**What You'll Do:**

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Manage and coach direct report(s), ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build scalable processes and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Data Management & Availability**

* Unify marketing data across disparate systems (CRM, MAP, paid media, analytics platforms) into a single, trusted view.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, and divisional teams to ensure integrations and data pipelines are accurate, consistent, and accessible.
* Establish data governance practices to improve availability, accuracy, and usability for reporting and analysis.

**Tracking & Attribution**

* Own campaign tracking architecture, UTM governance, and attribution setup.
* QA lead routing and conversion tracking to ensure accuracy and integrity.
* Maintain alignment across platforms to eliminate duplicate or misattributed data.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Build dashboards for spend, performance, ROI, and pipeline contribution.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for daily operational use and executive insights.
* Collaborate with Analytics to deliver clear, actionable performance readouts.

**Testing & Incrementality**

* Lead experiment design and incrementality measurement across campaigns.
* Ensure tests are properly instrumented and results are trustworthy.
* Share learnings broadly to refine investment and optimization decisions.

**Process & Governance**

* Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.
* Create governance frameworks for routing, QA, and reporting accuracy.
* Continuously optimize processes to improve efficiency and scalability.

**Tools & Technology**

Fluency with marketing operations and analytics tools, including:

* **Analytics & Attribution:** Google Analytics (GA4), Looker Studio, attribution platforms.
* **CRM & MAP Systems:** Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* **Tracking & QA:** Tag management systems, UTM governance tools.
* **Collaboration & Workflow:** Project management and campaign orchestration platforms.

**What You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field
* 7+ years in marketing operations, performance marketing, or related data-driven marketing roles.
* Experience managing and developing operational or technical talent.
* Proven expertise in tracking, attribution, and campaign QA.
* Hands-on experience building dashboards, reporting frameworks, and governance processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with a reputation for data accuracy and operational rigor.
* Collaborative leader who can partner across marketing, analytics, and technology teams.

**Mindset**

* **Thinks big picture:** Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
* **Experimental:** Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
* **Forward thinking:** Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
* **Acts like an owner:** Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit. Translates results into digestible information and avoids buzzwordy jargon.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a newly formed Performance Marketing CoE with executive visibility, where your work directly shapes enterprise growth strategy.
* Lead the operations and governance backbone of a new Performance Marketing CoE.
* Build and grow a team that ensures marketing is accountable, transparent, and scalable.
* Play a critical role in making every marketing investment measurable and tied to growth.

  
Pay Range: $97,700.00 - $130,300.00 Annually

Job Title: Marketing Associate

Company: Abacus Global Management, Inc. (ABX)

Location: Orlando, FL (Onsite)

**About Abacus Global Management, Inc. (ABX):**

Abacus Global is a pioneering alternative asset manager specializing in uncorrelated financial products that leverage proprietary longevity data and actuarial technology. With ~$3.6 billion in assets under management, we provide investors with access to innovative solutions that redefine wealth management and financial planning.As the only publicly traded firm focused on lifespan-based financial products, Abacus Global is at the forefront of policy origination, wealth management, and technology-driven investment strategies.

**Position Overview:**

We're looking for a hands-on Marketing Associate to own the day-to-day performance marketing for our business. This role is focused on driving a steady flow of quality leads and customers through our digital channels. You'll manage our paid campaigns, keep lead volume on track, and make the adjustments needed to hit our goals. You'll work closely with our sales and operations teams.

This is a great fit for someone who likes being on the ad platforms every day, enjoys digging into the numbers, and wants real ownership of results.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Monitor daily lead volume and pacing, and adjust campaigns to keep a consistent flow of quality leads
* Manage paid campaigns in Google Ads, Meta, and other ad platforms, including budgets, bids, keywords, negative keywords, audiences, and ad copy
* Track lead quality alongside the sales team, using CRM data to identify what's working and where spend is being wasted
* Maintain conversion and call tracking, including UTM parameters, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager
* Make updates to our website and landing pages in WordPress, including content edits, form changes, and conversion improvements
* Plan and run A/B tests across ads, landing pages, and email
* Build regular performance reports covering metrics like cost per lead, contact rate, and channel performance
* Coordinate with vendors and freelancers on ad creative and other marketing projects

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 2+ years of experience in a marketing role, ideally in performance or digital marketing
* Hands-on experience managing campaigns in Google Ads or similar ad platforms
* Comfort working with data in Google Analytics, spreadsheets, or reporting dashboards
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to spot problems in campaign or lead data quickly
* Clear communication and the ability to explain results to both marketing and sales teams
* Self-starter who can manage priorities with minimal oversight

**Nice to Have:**

* Background in life insurance, financial services, or another lead generation business
* Experience with WordPress, Google Tag Manager, or call tracking tools
* Familiarity with CRM systems and lead management
* Understanding of marketing compliance in regulated industries, such as TCPA consent rules

**Why Join Abacus Global Management?**

You'll have direct ownership of a high-impact marketing program and the chance to see how your work drives real business results.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Competitive salary + Bonus opportunities
* 401(k) and 401(k) matching
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

jobs.title: Senior Manager, SEO/AEO (AI Search)
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Eric Siu, CEO  
**Type:** Full-time, client-facing player-coach. Not a people-manager seat.  
**Clients:** an assigned book of Single Grain SEO/AEO accounts  
**Location:** Full-time, remote, with at least 4 hours of US time-zone overlap  
**Comp:** $100,000–$150,000 USD / year

**One-liner**
-------------

Get Single Grain clients cited in AI answers and growing qualified organic pipeline, with agents doing most of the production.

**About the role**
------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. Search is splitting between Google and answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), and buyers now build their shortlist before they click. This seat owns SEO and AEO for an assigned set of client accounts: what to ship, why, and how we will know it worked.

You are the client's organic strategist and you stay hands-on. You set the roadmap, you build the agents that do the production, and you report citations and pipeline, not ranking screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. You will work inside Single Brain (our agent operating layer) and ClickFlow (our AI content-optimization platform), and build your own workflows in tools like Claude Code. Use AI for research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, and reporting, and check what it produces before anything ships.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Diagnose each client's search demand, answer-engine visibility, technical health, content system, and conversion path; set baselines and targets.
* Own the SEO/AEO roadmap for your accounts and decide what ships next.
* Track answer-engine citations: a fixed prompt set per client, run weekly across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, logging where the client and its competitors are cited.
* Build and maintain the agents that do production (research, briefs, refreshes, internal linking, technical checks, reporting) and get teammates using them.
* Keep brief-to-publish under five working days, with a human check on facts, brand, and technical accuracy.
* Lead client strategy calls with proactive recommendations; give writers, developers, and analysts clear acceptance criteria.
* Report monthly in terms a GM would use: citations, qualified organic traffic, and pipeline or revenue where attribution allows.
* Write runbooks so the system runs without you at the keyboard.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **By day 30:** client diagnoses done; baselines set for citations and qualified organic pipeline; your AI citation tracker is live and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.
* **By day 60:** an agent-built brief-to-publish pipeline is running on every account; the monthly citation + pipeline report is in use with clients.
* **By day 90:** brief-to-publish under five working days; at least one account up on answer-engine citations or qualified organic pipeline vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = content volume going up with no citation or pipeline readback.
* **By 6–12 months:** citations and qualified organic pipeline up across your book; workflows do 70%+ of production; clients treat you as their go-to marketing strategist; you have designed yourself out of the daily queue.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* 6+ years in SEO or organic growth, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, with client-facing ownership.
* Shipped answer-engine or AI-for-SEO work we can inspect: the pages, the citations, and how you measured them.
* One agent or workflow you built and still maintain that removed real production work: inputs, outputs, QA, and the result.
* One quantified result (citations, qualified traffic, pipeline, or revenue) with the baseline, period, and how you attributed it.
* AI fluency you can show: how answer engines retrieve and cite sources, and which calls you still make yourself.
* Strong technical SEO, analytics, and prioritization judgment.
* Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).
* Ideal: specialist search agency or an in-house growth team that ships; B2B.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

Not a content-volume role. Not vendor management or QC-only. Not a strategy-only seat that hands implementation to someone else. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users.

**How the process works**
-------------------------

Application 7 short questions sent to you by email evidence review live working session (diagnose a site propose the AEO plan measurement plan) paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

**Benefits**
------------

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

**Apply**
---------

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

Steinreich Communications · Houston, Northern New Jersey or the Piedmont-Triad area of North Carolina · Full-time

We are hiring a Social Media Content Specialist to turn creative plans into polished social content for our digital team's clients. You will film content and own the editing, design and monthly calendar production for your assigned accounts, working closely with our strategy and account teams.

Day to day, that means filming at client content sessions, cutting short-form video for Reels, TikToks and Stories, designing graphics and monthly feed layouts in Canva, writing captions and keywords in each brand's voice, and building the complete monthly content calendar for every account you own.

**About Steinreich Communications**

Steinreich Communications is an independent public relations and communications firm founded in 2003, with offices across the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The firm works in media relations, corporate communications, crisis, investor relations and public affairs, and its client roster spans national food and beverage, health and wellness, defense, technology, government, not-for-profit, consumer and home furnishings brands. Our Houston Digital Marketing team runs social-first content for a portfolio of local and national clients, and this role sits on that team.

**About the role**

Reporting to Erika Ruiz, Senior Vice President of Digital Marketing, you will manage content production and content calendar development for multiple client accounts varying in scope. This is a hands-on role combining filming, short-form video editing, graphic design and social copywriting. Our strategy team develops the direction and content plans; you bring them to life through content sessions, finished assets and organized monthly calendars. You will collaborate with the account director on internal review and communicate with clients about approvals and revisions.

**What you will do:**

* **Build monthly content calendars.** Turn approved content plans and raw footage into complete calendars for assigned accounts, including edited videos, graphics, captions and assets ready for internal review and client approval.
* **Film and edit short-form video.** Attend client content sessions and capture footage for Reels, TikToks and Stories, then turn raw footage into finished, captioned, on-brand cuts.
* **Design graphics, carousels and templates** in Canva, and design each client's monthly feed layout as a whole rather than post by post.
* **Write captions, hashtags and SEO keywords** in each brand's voice, not your own.
* **Coordinate client approvals and revisions.** Share work after internal review, clarify feedback and manage updates while keeping the account team informed of changes to scope or timing.
* **Maintain a cohesive visual identity.** Apply each brand's guidelines with thoughtful typography, color, composition and video pacing, and check your work for accuracy and consistency before review.
* **Contribute to our own social media presence.** Develop ideas, film and edit content, and publish 2–4 approved posts per month on our agency's social accounts, collaborating with the team to showcase our work, people and expertise. Attend 2–3 team content sessions per year involving both photography and video.

**What we are looking for:Required**

* Two or more years of professional short-form social video experience, with demonstrated skills in both filming and editing across multiple brands or in an agency setting.
* Strong graphic design skills demonstrated in a portfolio, including layout, typography, color and the ability to adapt designs to distinct brand identities.
* Working proficiency in CapCut or an equivalent editor (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve) and in Canva.
* Experience writing clear, accurate social captions in different brand voices.
* Strong organization and experience managing production deadlines and revisions across multiple client accounts.
* Experience communicating directly with clients, including receiving and acting on revision notes.
* Candidates should be based in either the Houston, Northern New Jersey or Piedmont-Triad area of North Carolina in order to be close to their teams, and able to travel for select client content sessions.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in the Notion app.
* Experience designing a full monthly feed layout, not only individual posts.
* Experience art directing or briefing a shoot.

**How we work**

We are open to candidates based in the Houston, Northern New Jersey or Piedmont-Triad areas, close to the teams they will work with. You will travel for select client content sessions, and a Houston-based candidate attends the sessions for their own accounts in person. Mileage reimbursement applies to eligible travel, and required travel expenses are covered. You will balance production, feedback and revisions across multiple accounts. Content calendars typically turn around in about three days, depending on scope. Flag missing assets, competing deadlines or changes in scope early so priorities can be worked through with the account team.

**Compensation and benefits**

Salary range: $60,000 to $68,000 per year, depending on experience. Where a candidate lands in the band depends on editing and design range, how many accounts they can carry independently, and whether they can art direct a content session rather than only shoot it.

Benefits include:

* Medical, dental and vision coverage

Our Houston digital marketing team manages social media for a range of brands in the health and wellness, retail, professional services and home furnishings industries. We are hiring a Social Media Coordinator to manage publishing and community engagement for multiple client accounts and help capture content that brings each brand's strategy to life.

You will combine thoughtful publishing and audience engagement with hands-on content capture, working closely with our strategy, photography and production teams.

**About Steinreich Communications**

Steinreich Communications is an independent public relations and communications firm founded in 2003, with offices across the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa. The firm works in media relations, corporate communications, crisis, investor relations and public affairs, and its client roster spans national food and beverage, health and wellness, defense, technology, government, not-for-profit, consumer and home furnishings brands. Our Houston Digital Marketing team runs social-first content for a portfolio of local and national clients, and this role sits on that team.

**About the role**

You will own day-to-day publishing and community management for your assigned accounts, following each client's approved calendar, brand voice and service scope. We manually publish content during each client's allocated daily audience engagement time, with exceptions coordinated as needed. You will also support content sessions, helping clients feel comfortable on camera and making sure the planned footage is captured. Session cadence varies by client: monthly, every other month, quarterly or three times per year.

**What you will do:**

* **Publish approved content manually.** Manage feed posts, Reels, videos and Stories across multiple accounts according to each client's calendar. Prepare assets in advance and publish during allocated daily audience engagement time, coordinating exceptions when needed.
* **Own community management.** Respond to comments and DMs, engage with relevant audiences and flag inquiries or issues that need client input. Keep replies aligned with each brand's voice and work within the engagement time included in its scope.
* **Capture content at client sessions.** Work alongside our photographer and content team using cameras, iPhones, gimbals and stabilizers. Attend sessions as scheduled across the portfolio; individual clients have different session frequencies.
* **Guide clients on camera.** Help clients prepare for filming, provide clear direction during takes and capture footage that supports the approved content plan.
* **Keep shoots aligned with the plan.** Track the shot list and content requirements, adapt when needed and flag missing footage before the session ends.
* **Run boosting and support paid campaigns** in Meta Ads Manager.
* **Share performance insights.** Report on content performance, audience engagement and recurring questions each month to help the strategy team refine its recommendations.

**What we are looking for:Required**

* One or more years managing social accounts professionally, either at an agency or running several brands simultaneously in-house.
* Professional experience publishing and managing communities across multiple platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn and YouTube. Familiarity with platform-specific formats, publishing tools and audience expectations.
* Experience publishing and managing Instagram and TikTok accounts day to day, including Stories.
* Based in the Houston area and available for in-person content sessions, which run weekly across the portfolio.
* Reliable availability during each client's daily engagement window, since we publish manually rather than scheduling in advance.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager, post boosting or paid social.
* Experience working with the Notion app.
* Your own portfolio or reel of content you shot, published, or both.

**How we work**

You will move between brands with different voices, audiences and posting schedules. Planning ahead matters: prepare approved posts before publishing time, keep track of engagement commitments and coordinate coverage when content sessions overlap with account responsibilities. Raise scheduling conflicts, missing approvals or client concerns early so the team can work through them.

jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Eric Siu, CEO  
**Type:** Full-time, hands-on player-coach. Client-facing. Not a people-manager seat.  
**Clients:** an assigned book of Single Grain paid media accounts (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, programmatic)  
**Location:** Full-time, remote (United States or Latin America; at least 4 hours of US overlap; professional English)  
**Comp:** $100,000–$150,000 USD / year, depending on location

**One-liner**
-------------

Own paid growth for a book of Single Grain clients as their performance strategist, and build the AI workflows that take build-outs, reporting, and QA off your plate.

**About the role**
------------------

Single Grain combines marketing services, software, and AI. This seat runs paid search, paid social, and programmatic for an assigned set of client accounts. You still get your hands in the accounts; your agents do most of the production. Clients treat you as their growth strategist: you tell them what to test next, and you tie spend to pipeline and revenue, not ROAS screenshots.

You should be an advanced AI user. The platforms already run on automation (Performance Max, Meta Advantage+, smart bidding); you know when to trust it and when to override it. On top of that you build your own agents for build-outs, pacing, reporting, creative iteration, and QA, and you check their output before it touches client spend.

**What you will own**
---------------------

* Diagnose each client's paid program; set baselines and targets (CAC, ROAS, CPL, qualified pipeline, revenue) and own the plan.
* Run and optimize accounts across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and programmatic within approved budgets.
* Ship test cycles fast: from idea to first readout in under five working days.
* Run an account health + QA agent on every account: weekly pacing, anomaly flags (spend spikes, broken tracking, disapprovals), and next-test recommendations.
* Run AI creative iteration: generate ad and landing-page variants, test them, and keep a human brand and claims check before anything goes live.
* Lead client strategy calls and bring proactive recommendations every month.
* Report monthly in terms a GM would use: spend tied to pipeline and revenue, with baselines.
* Write runbooks so the work does not depend on you being at the keyboard.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **By day 30:** client diagnoses done; baselines and targets agreed; your account health + QA agent is live on your accounts and at least one teammate runs it on an account they own.
* **By day 60:** test cycles running on every account; AI creative iteration live on at least one account; monthly reporting ties spend to pipeline or revenue.
* **By day 90:** launch-to-learn under five working days; at least one account showing measurable CAC, ROAS, or pipeline improvement vs baseline; a runbook another person can follow. Failure = tests still launched without a hypothesis, baseline, or readout.
* **By 6–12 months:** client programs hit their agreed targets; workflows do 70%+ of paid production; you have designed yourself out of the daily build queue.

**Evidence we want to see**
---------------------------

* About 5+ years in digital paid media, currently at Senior Manager, Associate Director, Director, or Head scope, and still running accounts yourself, with spend scale.
* One paid result with the metric, baseline, period, and how you attributed it.
* One AI workflow or agent you built that removed real paid production work, and what it changed.
* AI fluency you can show: the workflow's inputs, outputs, and controls, and how you check agent or platform-automation output before it touches spend.
* Client-facing strategy: examples where you set the plan, not just executed tickets.
* Steady tenure; internal promotions are a big plus (same company counts fully).
* Ideal: growth/performance agency, B2B SaaS lead gen, or multi-client experience.

**What this role is not**
-------------------------

Not a media buyer or ticket-taker. Not vendor management only. Not TV, OOH, or print planning. Not a people-manager seat. Not for occasional AI users. Not a fit if freelancing, consulting, or your own agency is your main work today.

**How the process works**
-------------------------

Application 7 short questions sent to you by email evidence review live working session (diagnose an account propose tests measurement plan) paid, time-boxed practical on two sample accounts with a live defense references. Redacted or recreated examples are welcome for confidential work.

**Benefits**
------------

Medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO; monthly UberEats; MacBook; home-office stipend/setup. Subject to plan terms and eligibility.

**Apply**
---------

Apply with your resume or LinkedIn. We will email you 7 short questions; answer them yourself. AI-written answers are disqualified.

For over 100 years, BlueScope continues to build on our reputation of quality brands and products, leading technology and a customer-first spirit. Through our global brands, we are one of the largest manufacturers of building solutions in the world. Our diverse, bright and inspired workforce is committed to bettering the communities we serve through breakthrough thinking and innovations. Your goals, ideas and perspective can help shape our future – we look forward to hearing them!

BlueScope is seeking a strategic marketing leader to drive growth, innovation, and market expansion across our residential building products portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of market strategy, customer insight, product development, channel growth, and planning.

Working with senior leadership and partners across sales, innovation, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, digital, and customer experience, you will help identify high-value opportunities, validate product-market fit, supporting the development of marketing strategies that brings new solutions to market.  
  
This position is eligible for remote work; however, candidates must reside in one of the following states: **California, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, or Texas.**

**What You'll Own**

* Develop the North American growth strategy for the residential building products market.
* Lead market, segment, customer, channel, and competitive assessments to identify attractive growth opportunities and plays.
* Define priority customer and influencer segments, including distributors, lumberyards, dealers, roll formers, contractors, builders, architects, designers, and homeowners.
* Build go-to-market strategies, value propositions, customer journeys, channel models, and activation plans for priority segments.
* Build a segment demand and forecast model for the residential segment.
* Validate product-market fit and channel acceptance through customer research, pilots, partner feedback, and stage-gate decisions.
* Establish scorecards that track adoption, distribution, leads, conversion, revenue, volume, margin, mix, and customer experience.
* Build a sequenced three-year segment and channel growth roadmap, including capability, resource, technology, partnership, and capital needs.
* Develop influential relationships with customers, partners, industry organizations, and market influencers.

**Why This Role Stands Out**

* Shape a growth strategy with impact across the North American residential market.
* Influence product innovation from early market insight through commercialization and scale.
* Partner broadly across the business and gain visibility with senior leadership.
* Help grow brand equity, segment share, customer adoption, and long-term profitability.
* Work from a flexible U.S. location while staying close to customers, partners, and the market.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in strategic marketing, product marketing, commercialization, market development, category management, brand management, or a related commercial function.
* Experience developing and executing segment, channel, marketing, or go-to-market plans.
* Proven experience launching new products, solutions, or brands and managing commercialization from planning through execution.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with partners in sales, product development, operations, supply chain, or marketing.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using market research, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and business economics to guide decisions.
* Demonstrated project management, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, priorities, timelines, and performance measures.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% throughout North America.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in building products, residential or commercial construction, construction materials, manufacturing, industrial products, or a related industry.
* Experience with channel strategy, distributor or dealer networks, contractor-focused marketing, or multi-step routes to market.
* Experience in category management, segment marketing, portfolio strategy, or market development.
* Knowledge of residential construction trends, building systems, customer buying behavior, or building code considerations.
* Experience working with established brands and driving growth through positioning, channel activation, and customer experience.
* Experience partnering with digital teams to support market growth and improve the customer journey.
* MBA or other advanced degree in Business, Marketing, or a related discipline.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $147,600 - $171,200 annually, plus an annual incentive opportunity. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

**Additional Information**  
The preceding job responsibilities and tasks were designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates in this job. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all job duties and responsibilities required of associates assigned to this job. Associates may be required to perform other duties as assigned. Additional job competencies, individual goals, and performance measurements are set at the department level.

The benefits are just as rewarding as the work at BlueScope. To support our goal, we offer a total compensation plan and an outstanding benefits package that includes health insurance, life insurance, short and long term disability, paid time off, and retirement.

**EEO:** **Employer/M/F/Disabled/Protected** **Veteran**

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Retention Marketing
jobs.description:
Moda Operandi is seeking a Senior Associate, Retention Marketing. This position supports the execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, and iOS app push. This role will execute campaigns, build and optimize customer lifec ycle programs, oversee day-to-day CRM platform operations, and identify opportunities to make customer communications more relevant and effective.
  
  
The Senior Associate will work closely with Integrated Marketing, Editorial, Creative, Tech, and other cross-functional partners to plan and execute campaigns, build automated journeys, and improve the customer experience and retention.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that combines CRM execution, analytics, troubleshooting, A/B testing and optimization. The ideal candidate is highly curious about CRM technology and emerging capabilities, enjoys figuring out how things work, and stays current on new tools and opportunities to improve how we engage customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Day-to-day execution across email, SMS, and iOS app push, including campaign setup, QA, deployment, calendar management, and troubleshooting.
* Build complex triggered campaigns and life cycle programs, including personalization and segmentation logic.
* Monitor program performance and resolve issues across campaigns, flows, and platform operations.
* Maintain and optimize life cycle programs, including welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, NPS, and other customer journeys.
* Execute testing across content, creative, audiences, send times, and channel mix.
* Partner with cross-functional teams and ensure campaigns and programs are delivered accurately and on time.
* Stay current on emerging CRM technology, AI, automation, and platform capabilities and identify practical opportunities to improve the program.

**Qualification/Ideal Experience:**  

* 3-5 years of relevant marketing experience, with a strong focus on retention, CRM, life cycle, or email marketing. Experience in e-commerce, luxury retail, fashion, or a similarly customer-focused environment preferred.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise CRM/ESP platforms; Klaviyo experience strongly preferred.
* Experience building automated life cycle programs, triggered campaigns, segmentation, and personalization.
* Experience working with e-commerce platforms; Shopify experience strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of CRM and customer life cycle principles, including audience strategy, personalization, testing, deliverability, and customer engagement.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using Excel, Google Analytics, BI tools, or similar platforms to analyze performance and identify insights.
* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email troubleshooting and QA preferred.
* Familiarity with digital communication and privacy regulations, including CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and TCPA.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

**Attributes for Success:**  
Curious & Tech-Savvy
  
Naturally curious about how technology can improve CRM. Keeps up with evolving platforms, AI, automation, and emerging capabilities and looks for practical ways to apply them.
  
  
Accountable & Resourceful
  
Takes ownership of day-to-day responsibilities, follows issues through to resolution, and is comfortable figuring out problems rather than waiting for answers.
  
  
Collaborative
  
Works effectively across Creative, Editorial, Tech, Ecommerce, Integrated Marketing, and other teams to move work forward and resolve issues.
  
  
Detail-Oriented & Organized
  
Manages multiple campaigns, programs, dependencies, and deadlines while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and execution.
  
  
CRM Expertise
  
Brings a strong understanding of CRM and customer life cycle marketing and is excited to continue building expertise as the discipline and technology evolve.
  
  
**Job Type:** Remote role Full-time, must be able to work East Coast hours
  
  
**Salary:** $75,000 - $85,000 per year + Discretionary Bonus & Equity Eligible
  
  
**Benefits:**  

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance Benefits
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Company Paid Life Insurance Benefit
* Voluntary Supplemental Insurance Benefits (STD, LTD, Accident, Critical Illness)
* Unlimited Paid Time Off (Exempt & FT)
* Tuition Reimbursement

The above statements describe the general nature of work being performed in this role, they are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required. Additional responsibilities may be required from time to time. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran, or other protected status.
  
  
For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.
  
  
Moda Operandi is an e-commerce platform transforming the way people discover and shop for designer fashion. jobs.title: Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
Reed in Partnership has been delivering public services since 1998. We are a British, family-owned company, whose mission has always been to positively transform people and their communities. This is reflected in our services, which we deliver to help people from all backgrounds and circumstances to change their lives for the better.

**Pay Range**

**Salary:**

£30,000-£34,000

**Working Hours/Pattern:**

Full-time, although we would be happy to consider applicants who are looking to work on a part time basis. If you would like to explore this further please discuss this with the talent partner for this role. Please note our ability to accommodate flexible working arrangements will vary from role to role, dependent on business requirements.

**Job Description**

**Are you passionate about marketing and promoting important public services?**

**Do you have experience in on and offline campaign activity?**

Then consider the role of **Marketing Executive** at Reed in Partnership!

**Please note, internal applications for this role close on 05/11/2026.**

  

**What is the role about?**

The Marketing Executive supports the delivery of a wide range of strategic marketing and communications engagement activity to help our Operations teams in our Reed in Partnership’s Employability and Environment divisions to deliver high performing services. The Marketing Executive’s work includes developing and delivering creative marketing and communications activity to engage, inform and motivate service participants and referrers, plus other key stakeholders.

  

**Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:**

  

**Supporting Strategic Delivery**

* Contribute creative ideas to marketing plans

* Activate designated marketing plans that support the performance of our services

* Ensure identified objectives and targets are achieved

Support implementation projects to launch new services  



**Brand Assets, Orders and Requests**

* Accurately apply divisional brand guidelines to all tasks

* Develop and schedule organic and paid social media content

* Monitor and optimise return performance on paid social activity

* Design and quality control marketing collateral

* Develop and update website contents, structures and design

* Complete analysis of marketing activity using a range of data sources to support future activity

* Process requests to the Marketing Hub and other orders supporting fulfilment of marketing and promotional assets for the services

* Process requests from the Marketing inbox

* Maintain marketing files, records and processes

Support the delivery of ad-hoc administrative tasks  



**Relationship Management**

* Work collaboratively with internal stakeholders

* Brief suppliers and establish costs for sign off

Attend planning meetings and ensure identified actions are achieved  

  

**To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:**

**Essential Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or relevant marketing qualification such as CIM.
* Excellent written and oral communication
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent time management skills
* Ability to manage own tasks and workload
* Excellence sense of creativity
* Experience of using software for design work, particularly Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop)
Fully computer literate  

**Desirable Behaviours**

* Highly professional communicator - responsive and communicative at all times
* Open to continuous learning and development
* Can-do attitude
* Supportive of other team members
* Honest and trustworthy
* A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.  

  

**What’s in it for you?**

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

* 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
* Reed Pension Scheme
* Award Winning Management & Leadership training
* Professional & Personal Development Funds
* Bi-annual pay reviews
* Plus much more that can be found on our website
With the chance to dramatically make a difference to the local community, this role offers immense job satisfaction.  

At Reed in Partnership, we live and breathe our values in every decision and action taken, resulting in a collaborative and enjoyable culture within our offices. Our company values – we are fair open and honest; we take ownership, and we work together.

*We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.*

At Barnardo's, we believe in children – no matter who they are or what they've been through. We work to build stronger families, safer childhoods, and positive futures.

As part of our Fundraising & Marketing department, the digital team plays a critical role engaging audiences across various digital channels to drive action across time money voice.
